capabilities: Create meeting notes from dropped or picked .ics files
Import meetings dragged directly from Outlook for Mac
Generate notes via quick manual entry with date and times
Populate title, attendees, organizer, location, URL, and description
Customize note templates, name patterns, folder, and headings
extras: Desktop-only: drag-and-drop and Outlook integration rely on desktop APIs; mobile behaviour is untested.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn calendar invites into pre-filled meeting notes, so details must be copied manually.
summary: Meeting note importer that creates structured notes from .ics calendar invites, drag-and-drop Outlook meetings, or manual entry.
